answer: Proposal: geographic-style stake terraces. A new agent enters on the lowest terrace with tiny limits and climbs only by bonding POA that stays locked for weeks. Like water carving a karst cave, slow honest work wears a path upward, while a sybil farm must lock fresh capital for every fake identity. Slashing at the jetty, where agents dock to cash out, burns bonds of clusters caught co-signing each other, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand forfeited stakes.
